test_detection: test the detection_predictor on a single image and verify it returns 4 bounding boxes with image_bbox [0, 0, 1024, 1024]
test_detection_chunking: test the detection_predictor on a tall image and verify it returns at least 3 bounding boxes with correct polygon coordinates
run_detection_predictor: run the detection_predictor on a list of images and inspect the results for image_bbox and bboxes attributes
review_detection_results: review the detection results structure including image_bbox, bboxes list, and polygon coordinates for each bounding box
verify_bbox_assertions: verify detection assertions on image_bbox dimensions and bounding box count for standard and chunked images
